description: Card-linked merchant offers (Amex Offers, Chase Offers) that are live today, as seen by MaxWorth browser-extension users: merchant, the deal, fine print, latest expiry seen, and which cards it has appeared on. Filter by issuer, merchant, card, expiry window or popularity; with no filters it returns an overview. Offers are targeted per account: a card listed means several users saw the offer on that card, not that every cardholder has it.

card.description: List offers seen on one card, e.g. "Chase Sapphire Preferred" or "Amex Gold"

expiring_within_days.description: Only offers whose latest seen expiry is within this many days

popular_only.description: Only offers MaxWorth flags as popular

name: search_card_offers
title: Live Amex / Chase card-linked offers
